title: pinus kesiya var. langbianensis
intro: Pinus kesiya var. langbianensis, commonly known as the Langbian pine, is a variety of the Khasi pine tree, native to the Langbian Plateau in Vietnam. It is a type of evergreen tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus kesiya var. langbianensis include relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as treating wounds and skin conditions due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
